text:
steve_acme: Hey team — I just redeemed a gift token 'ACME-START-50' in the web UI. It showed a green check and said 'Credits added', but our org balance is still 0. Org: acme-inc (org_abc123). Happened ~10:12 UTC. Can someone look?

maria_support: Thanks @steve_acme — sorry about that. Can you DM the redemption screenshot or paste the confirmation text here? Also confirm the email/user you used. I'll pull ingestion logs.

steve_acme: Sent the screenshot to your DM. user: steve@acme.com. UI confirmation had txn id 'txn_9b7c' in the little toast.

ledger-bot: webhook_delivery: gift-service -> ledger 200 OK, id=wh_334455, payload_id=payload_9b7c

ajay_billing: Looking now. maria, can you confirm org id again? I'll query the ledger for txn_9b7c.

ajay_billing: ```sql
SELECT id, external_id, amount, account_id, created_at
FROM ledger.transactions
WHERE external_id = 'txn_9b7c';
-- no rows returned
```

ajay_billing: We have a webhook ack but no matching transaction row. Suspect mapping applied to a different billing account.

devon_sre: We rolled out a change last week to SSO->billing mapping for new orgs. Could be the redeem service wrote to the linked billing account (billing_acct_zz) instead of org_abc123. I'll check the mapping service logs.

ajay_billing: Hitting the grants service for the redeem record:

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \"https://internal.grants.svc/api/v1/redeems/txn_9b7c\" | jq
```

Result: `{ "id": "txn_9b7c", "status": "accepted", "applied_to": "billing_acct_zz", "amount": 50 }`

ajay_billing: Confirmed — the service applied the grant to billing_acct_zz (a closed/legacy billing account) instead of org_abc123. That's why org balance stayed 0.

maria_support: OK — thanks for the detective work. I'm going to perform a manual correction and run a backfill for other redeems in the same window. @ajay_billing can you run the manual ledger insertion and adjust the balance? I'll keep @devon_sre looped for the mapping fix.

ajay_billing: Performing manual create now.

ajay_billing: ```sql
-- manual fix (sanitized)
INSERT INTO ledger.transactions (id, external_id, account_id, amount, kind, created_at)
VALUES ('ledger_5555', 'txn_9b7c', 'org_abc123', 50, 'promo_redeem', now());
UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance + 50 WHERE id = 'org_abc123';
```

ledger-bot: ledger.update: account=org_abc123 balance_before=0 balance_after=50 tx=ledger_5555

steve_acme: I can see the balance now — 50. Thanks everyone :tada:

maria_support: Great — thanks for confirming. We'll open a follow-up to patch the grants->billing mapping logic and add a retry/backfill for webhooks that were acked but didn't create ledger rows. I'll CC product + infra and share an email update.

devon_sre: I'll add a monitor to alert when webhook_delivery=200 but no ledger row within 2 minutes. Also opening a bug for the mapping change.

steve_acme: Appreciate the fast turnaround. Any ETA on a permanent fix?

maria_support: We'll aim to include the mapping fix in the next sprint (priority P1 for reliability). We'll follow up via email once tickets are created. Closing this thread after we track the postmortem.
